messages.subject: Project Larkspur - Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Daniel,

Attached is our Report on Title and Acquisition for Kestrel House. In short, you can safely proceed to exchange and completion at £14.25m, subject to (a) the Northbank discharge undertaking in agreed form, (b) satisfying the TOGC conditions, and (c) putting buildings insurance in place from exchange.

Key points: passing rent £1,041,500 p.a.x. across six tenancies; WAULT 6.4 years to expiry; outstanding Aldermere rent review (conduct to be assigned to you); SDLT will be £702,000.

Happy to talk it through.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate - Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
